identity.name: Alpinist

case.bezel: none — internal rotating compass bezel operated by a crown at 4 o'clock

identity.one_liner: A green-dial field watch with an internal compass bezel that ran an eleven-year production before Seiko discontinued it in 2018.

provenance_events.description: The SARB017 runs 2006-2018 as the most-cited modern Seiko Alpinist — 39mm, caliber 6R15, green dial, internal rotating compass bezel. The 2020 SPB121 reissue revives the model with the 6R64 movement.

narrative.story: The SARB017 'Alpinist' pairs caliber 6R15 with an internal rotating compass bezel, operated by a secondary crown at 4 o'clock, under a green sunburst dial with gold cathedral hands. Seiko introduced the SARB line, including the Alpinist, in 2006, and it built a following among collectors for its field-watch functionality at a modest JDM price. Seiko discontinued it in 2018 after an eleven-year run.
narrative.collector_notes: The internal compass bezel should turn freely and align accurately when set from the 4 o'clock crown; a stiff or misaligned bezel usually means a service is overdue.
